svg.title: Uniracers logo, letter interiors
svg.desc: Thirteen smooth vector silhouettes of the interiors of the Uniracers lettering. The spiral dot over i, the first r terminal flourish, and both small lower dots are included. No exterior outlines, decorative background, or backing rectangle.
svg.metadata: Traced from user-supplied 1536x464 image; source SHA-256 655756a08fe44af0025efc46fb2b3563a3515247342d8e0fa0145b1200ef983e. Original black-letter regions thresholded and hand-selected; smooth closed Bezier contours.
